name: Marche
summary: The regional emblem on white: a stylised woodpecker overlapping a black letter M, inside a green-bordered shield.
origin: The emblem was adopted in 1980. With no flag law, the emblem was placed on white for the Quirinale display on 4 November 1995.

symbols.name: Woodpecker
symbols.meaning: The Picentes, an ancient people whose totem animal was the woodpecker (picus).

facts: The woodpecker comes from the legend of the Picentes, led to the area by a woodpecker.
clues: A woodpecker merged with the letter M in a green shield, on white.
Its bird comes from an ancient people's legend.
